headings: WHITE POWDERY SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4)

jsonld_raw.name: WHITE POWDERY SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4)
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented ceramic wardrobe bars. They can be hung on the wardrobe rail, from hangers or between clothes, even inside drawers.
Pack includes 4 units.

White Powdery | Pays homage to the best personal care traditions. It fuses the opulence of rose and the delicacy of lily to create a timeless floral essence, with hints of amber and pomegranate. A powdery base of ylang and cedar envelops this iconic fragrance.

Olfactory notes: 
Top notes: bergamot, orange, pomegranate.
Heart notes: rose, orris root, ylang, powdery.
Base notes: oak moss, amber, cedar.
